title: Día - Armchair
description: , designed for easy assembly and disassembly
Aesthetically, the chair features a pronounced inverted diagonal tilt
isual harmony between strength and comfort while playing with an optical illusion
These pine elements allow for larger rounded edges, adding both structural strength and a refined aesthetic touch.

Although primarily crafted from a sheet material like plywood, the Día - Armchair features intricate V-cuts made with a 45-degree V-bit on a CNC machine, creating the illusion of being constructed from individual slats. Additionally, a 90-degree chamfer is applied to the outer edges, softening transitions and enhancing the chair’s visual appeal. These details add a unique aesthetic while preserving the efficiency and practicality of working with laminated materials.
ensuring both comfort and support for the user
The armrests are positioned at an optimal height to reduce strain, while the generous cushioning provides soft yet supportive seating.

Día - Armchair is its ability to be packed into a compact box with a volume of just 0.32 m³. This efficient packaging reduces shipping costs and environmental impact by optimizing space during transportation. Additionally, it simplifies storage and handling, making it easier for customers to receive and assemble the product at home. By minimizing the packaging footprint, the design aligns with sustainable practices while ensuring convenience and practicality
designed for easy assembly and disassembly

Ease of Repair and Extended Product Lifespan The simplicity of the plywood and pine components makes them easy to repair or replace if necessary. Their design allows for individual parts to be swapped out or fixed with little effort. This also means that the components can be sold separately, helping to extend the product's lifespan and reduce waste over time.
